### A Prayer of Watchfulness on Spy Wednesday
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-of-watchfulness-on-spy-wednesday-your-daily-prayer.html
Passage: Matthew 26:14-16
Points:
- Judas's betrayal stands as a sobering warning that mere proximity to Jesus does not prevent a hardened heart.
- No believer is entirely immune to the subtle pull of greed, pride, or worldly compromise.
- Deceptive desires lead people to sacrifice eternal treasures for fleeting earthly benefits.
- Believers must walk in humble vigilance and daily reliance on the Holy Spirit to stay faithful.

### The Sting of Judas' Betrayal
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/easter-devotionals/easter-devotional-march-29.html
Passage: Matthew 26:14-16
Points:
- Even though Jesus knew what was coming, the betrayal by an intimate companion deeply grieved Him.
- Betrayal cuts far more deeply when it comes from trusted friends rather than strangers.
- Judas demonstrated prior compromise and self-interest long before accepting payment from the priests.
- Jesus understands personal rejection firsthand and provides comfort to those walking through betrayal.
